scope: CAD B5-E inward Shell with removed faces and uniform thickness
checks: box wall and bottom: independently derived volume 1664 mm3 and area 1808 mm2
cylinder: independently derived volume 848*pi mm3 and area 888*pi mm2
multiple removed faces, valid single solid, impossible thickness and exact face identity rejection
source movement/rotation, missing face status, explicit rebind and downstream Boolean regeneration
Review/Apply, stale review invalidation, one-entry Undo/Redo and independent copies
document v21 validation/reload, actual STEP bytes and STL mesh; unresolved downstream export blocked
limitations: One or more removed faces, inward uniform thickness and one resulting solid
No closed hollow body, outward/variable wall thickness, automatic topology substitution or scaled source
Complex offset failure is rejected; arbitrary concave BRep offset success is not guaranteed
Independent copied Shell retains its snapshot; create a new Shell to choose faces on that copy
